pages.text: You can use $(bold)Charge Jump$() for jumping up higher.$(br)This helps you get over fences and climb high wall.$(br2)Though a simple skill, it should be helpful for you!

pages.title: How to Use
pages.text: $(bold)1.$() Stand still and hold sneak for about a second $(br)$(bold)2.$() Press jump, either while still sneaking or right after releasing shift.$(br2)Any movement key cancels the charge.
$(bold)Turn On / Off$()$(br2)You can turn this action on or off right here.
